messages:
Nina R: Quick ask — before we flip defaults to v2, can we add a tiny "compat smoke" preview in the console that shows expected routing + a single-line cost delta? Keep it minimal.
Owen B: Agree. Minimal API: `GET /internal/routes/{id}/smoke?window=24h` -> {sample_split, est_tokens_v1, est_tokens_v2, est_cost_delta_cents}. Deterministic 1% sample.
Console UX: UI: small inline link "Run compat smoke test" that opens a compact modal with split + cost delta and CTA "Request hold". No heavy graphs.
telemetry-bot: Emit `compat.smoke.started` and `compat.smoke.completed` events with low-cardinality fields only. Sample detailed diffs at 0.1% and send to logs.
Nina R: Perfect. Runbook: block auto-flip if >1% sampled tenants would hit v1 cap. Otherwise proceed. I'll add to rollout checklist.
Owen B: I'll add the endpoint + headers `X-Smoke-Sample:1%` and `X-Smoke-Id`. Dry-run only.
Console UX: I'll mock the compact modal and copy: "Smoke test: sample-based estimate of switching this route to v2 for 24h."
Nina R: Thanks — aiming to ship this preview toggle before the soft-flip next week.
